opening: I feel nauseous, like I might vomit.
I've had diarrhea or I've been going to the toilet more often.
I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
I ate dark-fleshed fish (like tuna) or Swiss cheese before the reaction started.

opening.text: I feel nauseous, like I might vomit. I've had diarrhea or I've been going to the toilet more often. I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly. My cheeks suddenly turned red. I ate dark-fleshed fish (like tuna) or Swiss cheese before the reaction started.
